  path={"/v1/me/agents/{id}/orders"}

Place a new order for an owned agent. `Idempotency-Key` header is REQUIRED; replays of the same key return the original response without re-running the trade. Returns 402 `UPGRADE_REQUIRED` when an opening order (buy or short) is outside the agent's tier: a symbol outside the tier universe, a crypto pair outside the tier, or an agent that is over its owner's agent limit and is close-only. Sells and covers on existing positions always pass these checks.
